title: Tool and method decision atlas for Performable Music 2026
principle: Audio arrangement and listening first; existing Waveform/Surge/plugdata prioritized. Tool names/quantitative benchmarks alone never imply aesthetic acceptance.

tools.name: Magenta Groove MIDI Dataset
tools.caveat: midi reference analysis only; 3.11MB MIDI-only; CC BY 4.0; not a direct club-techno corpus
tools.local_test: Extract timing/velocity distributions from human performances; compare to original groove

tools.name: Essentia
tools.caveat: onsets, beat/loudness, tonal/spectral features, dropouts; license/check installation separately
tools.local_test: Machine-check gaps, tonal changes, transient coverage; NOT perceived musical quality

tools.name: FluCoMa
tools.role: sound corpus slicing and feature-driven instrument
tools.caveat: Max/SC/Pd and CLI; verify local build and corpus permissions
tools.local_test: Create one 30-60-source original percussion corpus with 3 distinct sound states

tools.name: Surge XT
tools.caveat: Local agent previously reported install; re-inventory actual version and factory state
tools.local_test: Build differentiated low-end/percussion sources with saved editable presets

tools.name: Waveform Free / Pro
tools.role: DAW arrangement and actual audio export
tools.caveat: Prior local report opened Waveform 14 and exported WAV; GUI save/reopen, license remain unverified
tools.local_test: One writer. Prove native session open/reopen, stems and 24-bit WAV

tools.name: plugdata
tools.role: focused DSP patch and state machine
tools.caveat: Previously reported installed; verify version, patch state and export
tools.local_test: One unique custom delay / resonant instrument; keep to four semantic macros

tools.name: GrooVAE / Magenta Groove
tools.caveat: historical implementation; compatibility with Waveform or current Ableton not established
tools.local_test: A/B quantized vs human performance vs manually designed timing

tools.name: vjbake
tools.caveat: Apple Silicon macOS13+; 60fps JSON/ProRes data video; requires BPM input; unrelated to sound generation
tools.local_test: Once an approved WAV exists, bake exactly calibrated LinkOSC-like offline data

tools.name: LinkOSC
tools.caveat: GPL-2.0-or-later; latency and controls; no exact live kick/snare identity; `/beat` OFF by default
tools.local_test: Compare offline baked streams to live analysis on original approved audio

tools.name: Magenta RealTime 2 SMALL
tools.caveat: mrt2_small 230M works real-time on M1 Pro per model matrix, base 2.4B does not; actual host load test required; weights CC BY 4.0, code Apache-2.0
tools.local_test: Audio-only 60s steering with MIDI/hand control, no primary sound dependency on stage

tools.name: ACE-Step 1.5
tools.role: full-track/timbre moodboard and offline source generation
tools.caveat: MIT project; verify individual model weight licenses and actual outputs; likely Windows 4080S optional; do not claim commercial quality from benchmarks
tools.local_test: Use only as A/B ideas; rebuild accepted material in editable DAW and user-owned original sources

tools.name: Stable Audio 3 Small/Medium
tools.caveat: model-dependent Community License and revenue/use restrictions, terms and memory to be verified
tools.local_test: Use to test one-shot/timbre hypothesis, not as a replacement for compositional audition

tools.name: CLAP
tools.role: audio embedding and coarse similarity triage
tools.caveat: embedding similarity is not proof of duplicated composition, style copying, or musical quality
tools.local_test: Flag strongly similar candidate sound worlds and request blind ear review

tools.name: librosa
tools.caveat: onsets, tempo/spectral features; must measure against fixed samples
tools.local_test: Find long unexplained silence, rhythm density and timbral novelty

tools.name: Magenta RealTime 2 BASE
tools.caveat: official matrix M1 Pro no real-time, though may run offline; don't deploy live
tools.local_test: Test offline only if a later dedicated need exists

tools.name: Syntheon
tools.caveat: README confirms Vital, Dexed WIP; **not** Surge XT support; dependency audit first
tools.local_test: Resynthesize a user-owned novel percussion sound into editable Vital preset

tools.name: RAVE
tools.role: neural source resynthesis / custom timbral instrument
tools.caveat: training/packaging and beta VST work; not fast enough to depend on this week's stage score without test
tools.local_test: Train on short original sound corpus only if time and rights permit

tools.name: Somax2
tools.caveat: Max integration and nontrivial setup; licenses and real Mac test needed
tools.local_test: Record a phrase, generate a constrained response, compare to hand-edited answer

tools.name: TidalCycles
tools.caveat: Haskell/Tidal current source on Codeberg; GPLv3 code; output OSC/MIDI; not a final mixer
tools.local_test: Export controllable rhythmic patterns that are rendered through professional local sources

tools.name: Strudel
tools.caveat: current upstream on Codeberg; do not confuse WebAudio sounds with mature production
tools.local_test: Generate candidate note-event scores and export, not synth-only masters

tools.name: Sardine
tools.caveat: can be a local composition tool; additional runtime maintenance
tools.local_test: Generate controllable counter-rhythm while main clock remains DAW

tools.name: beat-link-cpp
tools.caveat: EPL-2.0; not needed for Ableton-only; must have actual CDJ/DJM hardware
tools.local_test: Only enable when show includes Pioneer DJ Link gear

tools.name: beatlink-max
tools.role: Max external for Pioneer DJ beat info
tools.caveat: depends on beat-link-cpp; real Pioneer gear required
tools.local_test: Tempo/beat messages into Max only when DJ hardware present

tools.name: oflike-metal
tools.caveat: macOS13+/Xcode; source notes MIT; use only after native renderer compile issue solved
tools.local_test: One tiny isolated 1080p experiment; not alternative music engine

tools.name: GLIC Metal SDK
tools.caveat: 28 certified live presets, not full original 144; effects are separate from music creation
tools.local_test: After music pass, one selective visual effect using same Show Score

tools.name: Syphon26
tools.caveat: BSD-3; developer preview; not classic Syphon compatible
tools.local_test: No urgency unless native inter-app transport is actually needed

tools.name: ObjectSpat JS Qwen
tools.role: LLM -> constrained math functions with schemas
tools.caveat: Ollama/Qwen for production, Claude offline dataset; original system controls actual lights, not music
tools.local_test: Adapt prompt-to-validated-action+evaluation pattern to musical states; do not run generated code unsandboxed

tools.name: Midi Data Generator
tools.caveat: archived lightweight C++ source; no evidence it produced any named current set
tools.local_test: Extract scheduling and phrase morph principles; avoid same-rule loop generation

tools.name: MusicGen AudioCraft
tools.caveat: source MIT but model weights CC BY-NC 4.0; no default commercial stage reuse
tools.local_test: No performance usage without specific licensing review

tools.name: IDyOM
tools.caveat: probabilistic symbolic prediction; not real brain responses; specialized setup
tools.local_test: Compare motif predictability vs withheld answer C44; artist listening decides

tools.name: Groove feature note export
tools.caveat: E-GMD 444h; dataset usage/license needs independent recheck; larger than needed
tools.local_test: Use only a small authorized subset if initial GMD inadequate

tools.name: ReaScript
tools.caveat: REAPER is not free indefinitely; do not swap working Waveform just for automation
tools.local_test: Only if objective Waveform automation dead-end is verified

tools.name: Ableton Live Max for Live API
tools.role: native clip, devices and mixer control
tools.caveat: requires lawfully authorized Live/Max, not guaranteed installed or saved
tools.local_test: When available, exactly scoped DAW scene control + Show Score

tools.name: Demucs
tools.caveat: archived and unmaintained; separation does not create sampling rights
tools.local_test: Study owned audio arrangements; do not publish stems from protected reference

tools.name: James Holden Group Humanizer concept
tools.caveat: interview describes method; no verified current distributable patch here
tools.local_test: Design original correlated microtiming that respects an anchor, no raw random humanize
